units.source_text: 薰大将恳切要求看看新生的小公子。

en.t: General Kaoru earnestly asked to see the newborn young lord.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得怕羞，但她想道：“如今何必拒绝他呢？

en.t: The Second Princess felt shy, but she thought, “Why should I refuse him now?

units.source_text: 此人只有无理求爱这一事是可恨的。

en.t: The only hateful thing about him was his unreasonable pursuit of love.

units.source_text: 除此以外，岂可拒绝他的要求？”

en.t: Apart from that, how could I refuse his request?”

units.source_text: 她自己并不作答，但教乳母抱小公子出去给他看。

en.t: She did not answer him herself, but had the nurse carry the young lord out for him to see.

units.source_text: 将门之子，当然不会丑陋。

en.t: A child of such a warrior house would of course not be ugly.

units.source_text: 这小公子长得异常白胖而美貌，声音洪亮，似乎已想说话。

en.t: The little boy was exceptionally fair, plump, and beautiful, with a strong voice, as if he already wanted to speak.
A smile appeared on his face from time to time.

units.source_text: 薰大将看了心中艳羡，恨不得这孩子变了自己的儿子。

en.t: General Kaoru saw him and felt intense envy, wishing this child could become his own son.

units.source_text: 可见他还是难于舍弃尘世的。

en.t: This shows that he still found it hard to renounce the world.

units.source_text: 他只是想：“我那不可挽回的故人，生前倘能和我做了夫妻，留下这样一个孩子，多么好呢。”

en.t: He only thought, “If the one I can never bring back had become my wife while she lived and left me a child like this, how wonderful it would have been.”

units.source_text: 但他绝不企望最近新娶的那个荣华的二公主何日早生贵子，其心情也太怪僻了。

en.t: Yet he never hoped that the splendid Second Princess whom he had recently married would soon bear him a noble child; his feelings were eccentric indeed.

units.source_text: 笔者把此君描写成一个如此儿女之态的痴人，其实对他不起。

en.t: In truth, I wrong this gentleman by portraying him as such a foolishly sentimental man.

units.source_text: 如果他真是一个不通道理的怪人，皇上不会特别亲近他而赘他为驸马。

en.t: If he truly were an unreasonable odd man, the Emperor would not have favored him especially and made him an imperial son-in-law.

units.source_text: 推想起来，此人在朝廷政治方面定是才能出众的吧。

en.t: From this one may infer that he must have had outstanding ability in court politics.

units.source_text: 薰大将看见二女公子肯将如此娇小的新生儿抱出来给他看，心甚感激，便比往常更亲切地和她谈话，不觉日色已暮。

en.t: Seeing that the Second Princess was willing to have such a tiny newborn brought out for him to see, General Kaoru was deeply grateful and spoke with her more warmly than usual, until before he knew it the sun had set.

units.source_text: 今日未便放心地在此逗留到深夜，心甚痛苦，只得连声叹气地告辞。

en.t: Today it would not do to stay there at ease until deep into the night, so in great distress he could only sigh again and again as he took his leave.

units.source_text: 他出去之后，也有几个饶舌的侍女说道：“此人留下的衣香多么芬芳啊！

en.t: After he went out, several talkative ladies-in-waiting said, “How fragrant the scent left in his robes is!

units.source_text: 真如古歌所谓‘折得梅花香满袖’，黄莺会来寻访呢。”

en.t: It is just like the old poem that says, ‘pluck a plum blossom and its fragrance fills your sleeves’; even the golden orioles will come seeking it.”
